newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - March 14.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - March 14.

text.p: * Employee Solutions Inc said Friday it expected fiscal fourth quarter earnings to fall below analysts' estimates. The warning came the morning after the company delayed the release of its financial results.
Employee Solutions closed at 15-3/8 Thursday, down 4-1/2, then collapsed after the bell when the delay in reporting results was announced. The shares plummeted 5-3/8 to 10 in after-hours trading.

* Philip Morris Cos Inc shares bounced 1-1/2 to 127-1/2 in London after sliding 11-1/2 in New York Thursday. Shares in RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp climbed 1/2 in London to 33-3/4, after a 2-7/8 drop in New York.
Tobacco shares were hit hard Thursday on news that the Mississippi Supreme Court had rejected a challenge to the state's Medicaid suit against tobacco companies.
